sentences.en: I can't bear to tramp ten miles in this heat.
sentences.zh: 我实在受不了在这热天里徒步走十英里。

sentences.en: Don't tramp in the living room with muddy feet.
sentences.zh: 别穿着泥脚在客厅里乱踩。

sentences.en: The tramp gobbled down the Thanksgiving dinner served at the church.
sentences.zh: 那个流浪汉狼吞虎咽地吃完了教堂里提供的感恩节晚餐。

senses.zh: 流浪汉；妓女；游民，流浪汉
